```yaml
name: Test Meshery Integration

on:
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'system/**'
      - '*.md'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  integration-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Sistent
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Verify test script exists
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          if ! grep -E '"test"\s*:' package.json > /dev/null; then
            echo "No test script found in package.json."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Pack Sistent
        if: steps.verify-test-script.outcome == 'success'
        run: npm pack
        id: pack

      - name: Find tarball
        if: steps.verify-test-script.outcome == 'success'
        id: tarball
        run: |
          TAR=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -name '*.tgz' | head -n 1)
          if [ -z "$TAR" ]; then
            echo "Tarball not found."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "tarball=$TAR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Checkout Meshery UI
        if: steps.verify-test-script.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: meshery/meshery
          path: meshery
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install Sistent into Meshery
        if: steps.verify-test-script.outcome == 'success'
        run: npm install ../${{ steps.tarball.outputs.tarball }}
        working-directory: meshery

      - name: Install Meshery dependencies
        if: steps.verify-test-script.outcome == 'success'
        run: npm ci
        working-directory: meshery

      - name: Build Meshery
        if: steps.verify-test-script.outcome == 'success'
        run: npm run build
        working-directory: meshery

      - name: Run Meshery tests
        if: steps.verify-test-script.outcome == 'success'
        id: test
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          npm test | tee test_output.txt
        working-directory: meshery

      - name: Report results
        if: always() && steps.verify-test-script.outcome == 'success'
        run: |
          echo "## Meshery Integration Test Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          if [ "${{ steps.test.outcome }}" == "success" ]; then
            echo "✅ Integration tests passed." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          else
            echo "❌ Integration tests failed." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo "See test output below:" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            cat test_output.txt >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          fi
        working-directory: meshery

      - name: Report no test script
        if: steps.verify-test-script.outcome != 'success'
        run: |
          echo "## Meshery Integration Test Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "⚠️ No test script found in Sistent package.json. Skipping integration tests." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
